scope: Proposition 4.2 (Uniform scheduling bound) of the manuscript “Uniform computation of the squared-logarithmic k-server bound” (preprints/Uniform-computation-of-the-squared-logarithmic-k-server-bound-September-24-2026/Uniform-computation-of-the-squared-logarithmic-k-server-bound-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 110 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2e665c0419f62ed4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is one polynomial p, independent of the instance, such that preprocessing uses at most p(L) bit operations and serving request t uses at most p L + ⌈log2(t + 1)⌉  bit operations, for every reachable history and internal state. Activation occurs at a finite determin- istic time t∗ depending only on (n, k, d).
